name: Donnelley Foundation Chicago Region Land Conservation Grants
summary: General operating and project grants to 501(c)(3) conservation organisations protecting and stewarding natural areas and working lands in the greater Chicago region. New applicants first talk to a program officer.

geography.label: Greater Chicago region (Illinois, Wisconsin and Indiana counties)

fiscal_sponsor.note: The sponsor is a 501(c)(3) public charity

steps: Conversation with a program officer about fit (new applicants)

eligibility.rule: A 501(c)(3) public charity, or fiscally sponsored by one
In compliance with the Secretary of State where the organisation is headquartered
Completed at least one full fiscal year of operations before applying
No environmental education programmes or religious activities
No trails, bike paths, developed parklands, gardens, nature centers, bioswales, green roofs or permeable pavements
No political campaigns, electoral politics or lobbying on pending legislation
No stand-alone conferences, publications, films, events, websites or videos
No endowments, capital campaigns or debt reduction

documents: Secretary of State compliance confirmation (a screenshot is fine)
Fiscal sponsorship agreement, if fiscally sponsored
List of current board members, with officers marked
Financials (audit, 990 or internal figures) for the last two completed fiscal years
Current-year organisation budget with year-to-date actuals
Bank letter or voided check to confirm ACH payment details

pool.quote: The annual overall grant budget for Chicago Land Conservation is $1.5 million.

applicant_types.quote: Organization must be a 501(c)(3) public charity (or be fiscally sponsored by one).

geography.quote: Organization or project must have a strong nexus to land conservation in the greater Chicagoland geography, which includes an emphasis on the Illinois Counties of Cook, DuPage, Kane, Kankakee, Kendall, Lake, McHenry, and Will;

access.quote: We offer general operating and project grants to organizations that further natural and working land protection and stewardship in the greater Chicago region

amount.quote: Typical grant sizes range from between $15,000 to $75,000.

fiscal_sponsor.quote: Organization must be a 501(c)(3) public charity (or be fiscally sponsored by one).

effort.quote: Prospective applicants must share more about their work to determine potential fit before applying.
Log into the Grantee Portal to complete your application.

eligibility.quote: Organization must be a 501(c)(3) public charity (or be fiscally sponsored by one).
Organization must be in compliance with the Secretary of State where it is headquartered.
Organization must have completed at least one full fiscal year of operations before applying.
Environmental education programs and religious activities.
Projects for trails, bike paths, developed parklands, community and school gardens, nature centers, botanic gardens, bioswales, rain gardens, green roofs, and permeable pavements.
Projects or activities that involve political campaigns, electoral politics, or lobbying on pending legislation.
Stand-alone conferences, publications, films, events, websites, or videos.
Endowments, capital campaigns, or debt reduction.

after_award.quote: GDDF uses both progress and final reports to help us assess the impact of our grantmaking and to better understand your work.
Multi-year grants are paid out annually upon receipt and review of an annual progress report.

documents.quote: A screenshot is acceptable. Must be valid/unexpired at the time of your application. Must be in compliance with the Secretary of State where the organization is headquartered.
Please upload your fiscal sponsorship agreement
Please upload a list of your organization's current staff
Please upload a list of your organization's current Board members Please indicate Board officers
For the fiscal year two years prior - please submit one of the following, listed in order of preference:
Organization Budget for the current fiscal year, including year-to-date actuals
To confirm your banking information please upload a copy of a bank letter or voided check.
